fields.name: ArgentSeaGatewayListProvider gateway-list contract
fields.contract: ArgentSeaGatewayListProvider implements the gateway-list provider contract: GetGateways retrieves gateway endpoints by executing ClusterClientDbOptions.GatewayListQuery, or Queries.OrleansClusterGatewayList (rdr.OrleansClusterGatewayListV1) when that option is unset, with the configured cluster identifier as @ClusterId, then returns one gateway URI for each [IP-address bytes, port, generation] result row. MaxStaleness exposes the configured maximum refresh interval; IsUpdatable is always true. InitializeGatewayListProvider completes without retrieving gateways.
